Rashi on Menachot 90a:10:1.hebrew: רבי עקיבא סבר מדת יבש לא נמשחה כל עיקר - וחול היא, לפיכך מה שבפנים בכלי קדושת פה הוא דמקדש ליה, הילכך מה דאיצטריך ליה מקדש, בירוצין דלא צריך ליה לא מקדש, לפיכך בירוציהן חול:
Rashi on Menachot 90a:10:1.english: Rabbi Akiva holds that the measure for dry goods was never anointed at all - and it is non-sacred; therefore, what is inside the vessel is consecrated by the sanctity of its designated fill line, and so whatever amount is needed is consecrated, while the overflow, which is not needed, is not consecrated. Therefore, their overflow is non-sacred.

Rashi on Menachot 90a:12:1.hebrew: למאי דצריך - למה שבתוך הכלי איכוין למיקדש, ולא לבירוצין, ואמאי מיקדשי הבירוצין:
Rashi on Menachot 90a:12:1.english: "That which he requires" - He intends to consecrate only what is inside the vessel, and not the overflow; so why should the overflow become consecrated?

Rashi on Menachot 90a:13:1.english: 'Not knowingly' - even though he did not intend to consecrate the overflow, the sacred vessels (vessels of service) sanctify it regardless.

Rashi on Menachot 90a:13:2.hebrew: גזירה שמא יאמרו - דמאן דחזי דהנך בירוצין לא קדשי, אע"ג דאתו מגוויה דמנא, אמרי הכי נמי מוציאין מכלי שרת לחול. אבל יבש, דלא אתי מגופיה דמנא, לא אתו למימר ביה מוציאין מכלי שרת לחול:
Rashi on Menachot 90a:13:2.english: A decree lest they say - For one who sees that these overflows are not consecrated, even though they come from inside the vessel, will say the same of it: that [substances] may be taken from a service vessel to non-sacred use. But dry [flour], which does not come from the body of the vessel, they will not come to say of it that [substances] may be taken from a service vessel to non-sacred use.

Rashi on Menachot 90a:1:1.english: IS THERE A VOLUNTARY GUILT-OFFERING? — Hence, it may be sacrificed on the altar only together with its libations.

Rashi on Menachot 90a:3:1.english: Its heaping was within it - [The Kohen Gadol's measuring vessel] was so large that when it was leveled off, it already held a full tenth [of an ephah].

Rashi on Menachot 90a:4:1.english: "For the measure of dry goods, their overflow is non-sacred" - What falls from the vessel after it has been filled, that is the "overflow" (birutzin).

Rashi on Menachot 90a:5:1.hebrew: אלא שהלח נעקר - שהבירוצין נכנסו בכלי ונתקדשו בו, ושוב נעקרו ממנו כשנפלו חוץ, לפיכך הן קדש, דנכנסו בכלי ונתקדשו בו:
Rashi on Menachot 90a:5:1.english: Rather, [it is] that the liquid was displaced - The overflow had entered the vessel and become consecrated there, and was then displaced from it when it spilled outside; therefore it is sacred, since it had entered the vessel and become consecrated in it.

Rashi on Menachot 90a:5:2.hebrew: ובירוצין של יבש אינו נעקר - מתוכו של כלי, שלא נכנס בתוך הכלי ולא נתקדש בו, לפיכך הוא חול:
Rashi on Menachot 90a:5:2.english: AND THE OVERFLOW OF DRY [MEASURES] IS NOT DISPLACED - from within the vessel; that is, [the dry overflow] never entered into the vessel and was never consecrated in it, and therefore it is non-sacred.

Rashi on Menachot 90a:6:1.english: Whose [opinion is this] - This is referring to that which is taught [in the mishna]: All the measures were heaped.

Rashi on Menachot 90a:6:2.english: IF [the mishna follows] RABBI MEIR — Since he stated above (Menachot 87a) that the heaped vessel, with which one measured the flour for all the other meal-offerings, [was different from] the level vessel that was the measure of the High Priest, which was so much larger that the amount that filled the [smaller] vessel when heaped would fill this one only to the level line.

Rashi on Menachot 90a:6:3.english: AND IT WAS LEVELED - meaning, there was not even one heaped measure at all.

Rashi on Menachot 90a:7:1.hebrew: ומאי כל מדות - דלא תימא כל המדות שהיו שם היו גדושות, דלא היתה אלא אחת גדושה:
Rashi on Menachot 90a:7:1.english: And what [does the mishna mean by] "all measures" - Do not say that all the measuring-vessels that were there were heaped, for there was only one that was heaped.

Rashi on Menachot 90a:7:2.english: Rather, this is what the mishna is teaching: All measurements [kol medidot] - the measurements that they took with it were heaped.

Rashi on Menachot 90a:9:1.english: They were not anointed on the outside - Therefore, their overflow is non-sacred.
